{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders
sales_clean = sales[sales['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales_clean[
    (sales_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (sales_clean['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

print(mean_revenue)"}
